CODE RED D0 READ-ONLY SHERLOCK ADAPTER. Begins only after C1 and B0R. It is JVM-specific acquisition code in the existing acquire module, with no new module or dependency.

Exact paths:
- acquire/.jvm/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/sherlock.scala
- acquire/.jvm/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/SherlockAtlasSuite.scala
- acquire/.jvm/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquireprobe/SherlockConstructionBoundarySuite.scala
- acquire/.jvm/src/test/resources/storymodel4s/acquire/sherlock/microsegments.tsv
- acquire/.jvm/src/test/resources/storymodel4s/acquire/sherlock/scenes.csv
- acquire/.jvm/src/test/resources/storymodel4s/acquire/sherlock/recalls.csv
- docs/data/sherlock/d0-replay-receipt.json

The committed resources are synthetic mutation fixtures only unless a text artifact has its own completed B0R admission. The real integration run reads caller-supplied admitted non-video Sherlock artifacts identified by B0R; it never reads, copies or decodes video bytes.

The smart-constructed adapter binds exact source, artifact, transform, axis and repair identities; validates schema, row identities, extents, missingness and membership; preserves Microsegment1000, Scene50 and TopicHmmEvent30 as distinct populations; emits proposal-bearing NarrativeSourceAtlas units with typed EvidenceSupport; retains coder rows as observations of coding acts and derivations of the episode; keeps TopicHmmEvent30 diagnostic in the feature-use ledger; and never mints accepted narrative claims or runtime-observed decoder evidence.

Courts: exact 1000-row and 50-scene input succeeds under the declared two-run repair; reset, scan break, zero or reversed duration, missing TR, 10.8-second tail, boundary disagreement and all-missing rating remain explicit; foreign artifact, source, axis, transform, repair receipt or segmentation identity refuses; conflating 1000, 50 and 30 IDs fails; fabricated episode-truth or linguistic-entailment status fails; alias mapping with the omitted source and shifted numbering is checked; real local replay is deterministic and its receipt contains no source prose or video bytes.

Gate: exact reference-scope JVM command; acquireJVM tests including construction probes; real local manifest-bound replay with deterministic receipt digest; scalafmtCheckAll; no network, decoder, model dependency or raw-video access; independent source and type-discipline review.
set.title: D0 read-only Sherlock NarrativeSourceAtlas adapter and replay
